history.quote: I preferred Claude Code for most of my work.

surface_source.quote: Given that I'm very accustomed to Claude Code, I haven't spent any more time optimizing this. I'm happy with the little flicker I get in VS Code. I wouldn't feel at home otherwise. And it still flickers less than Claude Code.

history.quote: I've since abandoned Claude Code and written my own coding agent harness, which has served me well over the past months.

review_style.value: Limits daily output to what he can review
review_style.quote: Set yourself limits on how much code you let the clanker generate per day, in line with your ability to actually review the code.

also.quote: After I see its initial review, I give my own review and then we work on it together until it's good. That's the workflow I use to not merge garbage code.

harness.value: pi in the terminal, tmux for long-running processes and sub-agents
harness.quote: There's simply no need for background bash. Claude Code can use tmux too, you know. Bash is all you need.

rules_files.value: AGENTS.md in the pi repo, shared with co-maintainers
rules_files.quote: Explain non-trivial designs and problems as: problem, concrete example or short trace, then solution. State why the solution is necessary and distinguish it from optional complexity.
